in_sanskrit.name: अनंग
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अनाधिक (anādhika) - without comparison, incomparable, unsurpassed, unequaled

in_hindi.name: अनंग

in_telugu.name: అనంగ
in_telugu.long_meaning: అధిక (adhika) - అధికమేయ (adhikamey) - beyond, more than, above; అనంగ (ananga) - beyond, more than, above, incomparable, unsurpassed, unequaled

in_marathi.name: Anang
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anang is a Sanskrit name that means 'nourisher', 'supporter'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anang', which means 'without hunger'. It is a name given to a child who is believed to bring happiness, prosperity, and success to his or her family.
